name: kimi-lm-provider
displayName: Kimi Language Model Provider for Copilot
description: Registers Kimi (Moonshot AI) models as VS Code language model providers for Copilot Chat

kimi.endpoint.markdownDescription: Select an API endpoint. When Custom is selected, the URL from #kimi.apiBaseUrl# is used.

kimi.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Custom API base URL. Only used when #kimi.endpoint# is set to Custom. Do not include `/chat/completions`.

kimi.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens allowed per request by this extension. This budget is reserved from the context window; it is not the model's documented maximum output capability.

kimi.sendDeviceInfo.markdownDescription: Send hostname, device/OS details, and a random session device ID to the configured API endpoint. Disabled by default; when disabled, this extension does not collect these details or send device information headers.

kimi.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort for supported Kimi Code models. Model Default omits the parameter and uses the server default. Ignored when thinking is disabled or the model does not support configurable reasoning effort.
